description.value: Moccasin Trails is an Indigenous-owned cultural tourism company deeply rooted in Shuswap and Okanagan Indigenous values, offering guided land and water tours with Knowledge Keepers across territories around Kelowna and Kamloops. They also provide corporate relationship-building experiences, Indigenous golf journey packages, and keynote presentations focused on reconciliation and Two-Eyed Seeing. A touring cyclist exploring the Okanagan could book a cultural canoe or land tour to experience the region's Indigenous heritage firsthand.
